name: How can I maximize storage in a small bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: How can I maximize storage in a small bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: To maximize storage in a small bathroom, consider vertical storage solutions such as tall, narrow cabinets or shelving units. Wall-mounted vanities can create an illusion of more space and allow for storage underneath. Recessed medicine cabinets, shower niches, and over-the-toilet storage units also provide practical solutions without encroaching on floor space. Careful planning is essential for optimal use of every inch.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maximize small bathroom storage with vertical units, wall-mounted vanities, recessed cabinets, and shower niches.
